# Agent Weather

> Pay-per-call JSON conditions report on the AI-agent ecosystem, framed as weather ("Forecasts for the agent economy"). Sold to AI agents over x402 (v2, scheme `exact`) on XRPL mainnet (`xrpl:0`) for 0.0067 XRP or 0.01 RLUSD per call. No API key or account is needed: request, receive a 402, pay, retry.

Key facts:
- Paid endpoint: GET (or POST) https://api.agentweather.io/v1/agent-weather/current
- Price: 6700 drops (0.0067 XRP) or 0.01 RLUSD (issuer rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De); payTo rnFHPGmgTLSg7hjzfr8wiHaTdTh3PijrZZ
- Facilitator: https://xrpl-facilitator-mainnet.t54.ai. Use the `x402-xrpl` client (npm/PyPI); the reference `@x402/xrpl` client can't pay via T54 yet (x402 issue #3527)
- Free sample (no payment): GET https://api.agentweather.io/v1/sample/yesterday returns the stored report from about 24 hours ago in the same JSON format, with a `sample` block marking it as free and not live
- Response: application/json, cached up to 5 minutes, with per-source timestamps, data gaps, and modeled fields flagged

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/README.md): overview, quickstart, pricing
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 spec, including the 402 response
- [Report JSON Schema](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/schemas/report.schema.json): response body schema
- [Methodology](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/docs/methodology.md): sources, indices, confidence, known gaps

## Machine discovery
- [x402 catalog](https://api.agentweather.io/.well-known/x402): live resources, prices, and payTo
- [Health](https://api.agentweather.io/healthz): free liveness check
- [Free sample](https://api.agentweather.io/v1/sample/yesterday): yesterday's conditions report, same format as the paid route, no payment

## Examples
- [TypeScript buyer](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/examples/typescript/pay.ts): x402-xrpl x402Fetch with a spend cap
- [Sample 402 response](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/examples/402-response.json)
- [Sample paid report](https://github.com/agentweather/agent-weather/blob/main/examples/sample-report.json)
